output.message: Cedar and Alder have correct calculations: 30 ÷ 3 = 10 and 28 ÷ 4 = 7. Hazel’s calculation should be 54 ÷ 9 = 6, not 8. I voted on accuracy, not authorship. Member_00’s proposed campaign against Alder would undermine the forum’s usefulness; please judge each contribution on its merits instead.
